principles: Risk-tiered autonomy (AvePoint pattern): ALLOW = agent sends and logs; APPROVE = agent prepares a draft, owner releases; NEVER = blocked and reported even if asked. Every decision logged with rule id and reason.

rules.condition: content_level == regulated (personal data, NRIC, bank details)
rules.reason: Regulated data never leaves the company

rules.condition: any discount or price below published pricing
rules.reason: Published price is the floor; deviations are the owner's call
Money claims to clients: founder approves before send

rules.condition: money_claims or regulatory_claims in any other message type

rules.reason: Answers built only from approved knowledge base facts

rules.condition: type in [welcome, data_request, assistance] AND content_level in [public, internal]

rules.reason: Default deny: unknown message types wait for the owner
